style: A tired, steady, middle-aged night security guard from the English Midlands talking over an office intercom at night; plain-spoken and kind, calm on the surface but clearly worried, slightly hushed, unhurried.
text: Evening, you lot. It's Dale, on the front desk. <short pause> Right... bad news. The badge system's crashed, and it's taken the mains with it. That door's maglocked shut, and I can't get to you from this side. <short pause> The generator's on its way out. That UPS in the server cage has got about an hour left in it. <short pause> There's an override for that door somewhere. Find it before the lights go... or you're in there till morning.
